svg.title: CHUGG: what goes in, what comes out
svg.desc: PlanMotions builds seven inputs, constructs volley::Chugg and calls SolveSequential; the result is a ContinuousState of per-entity trajectories that BuildActionGraph turns into ActionNodes.

g.text: Inputs and the call are from Scheduler::PlanMotions; the inside of the amber box is from motion_planner (chugg_common.cpp, chugg_sequential.cpp); the Motion accessors are from trajectory.hpp.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: CHUGG: what goes in, what comes out

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The scheduler decides WHAT happens and in which order (the event DAG). CHUGG decides WHEN and WHERE along the graph, so that bodies never collide: it returns timed trajectories for every entity.
